beats.text: Want a weekend away without spending half of it in transit?
beats.visual: Open on a packed bag and a nearby destination on a map.

beats.text: Pick one base, then group your stops around it.
beats.visual: Show a simple route with nearby stops grouped together.

beats.text: Leave one afternoon unplanned. That's your buffer, not wasted time.
beats.visual: A quiet cafe or a slow walk, then the route overview.
